<span class=\"n\">2.</span> Qué es una c: 2. What a cookie is, in plain words
Una cookie es un archivo de texto muy pe: A cookie is a very small text file that a website stores in your browser and that the same site can read back later. It lets the page remember something from one screen to the next, because without it every page would be the first one: you would sign in and, on clicking any link, you would be out again.
Junto a las cookies existe el <strong>al: Alongside cookies there is local storage (localStorage), which is similar but with one difference that matters: it never travels to our servers. <span class=\"n\">5.</span> Por qué no l: 5. Why we do not ask for consent with a banner
Puede que le llame la atención no encont: You may be surprised not to find the “accept cookies” window that appears almost everywhere. It is not an oversight: it is the consequence of not using the cookies that make it compulsory to ask.
La normativa europea de privacidad elect: European ePrivacy rules —and the equivalent rules in the countries where we operate— require prior consent for advertising, profiling and third-party analytics cookies. They do not require it for strictly necessary ones, nor for those that store a preference you asked for yourself, such as the light or dark theme.
